About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.

You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.

Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.

About the Job

This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.

You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.

You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
  • Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
  • Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
  • Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
  • Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
  • Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
  • Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
  • Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
  • Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
  • Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
  • SQL, plus Python or R.
  • Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
  • Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
  • Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
  • Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience in a B2C subscription business.

Core Expectations

  • You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
  • You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
  • On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
  • You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
  • You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
  • You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

About The Team

The Product Design team is the creative engine shaping the vision, strategy, and delivery of extraordinary member experiences at Life360. With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design.

The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360's subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. We set and hold the bar for experiment quality and methodology across the program, using tools like Statsig to run and govern testing at scale, and we ground every decision in research and data, validating or killing assumptions before they become a build.   • A track record of shipping and iterating on A/B or multivariate experiments in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined brief and turn it into a well-scoped, testable hypothesis using research or data.
  • A proactive, ideas-first mindset: someone who brings concepts to the table rather than waiting to be handed a fully-formed brief.
  • Strong collaboration skills, able to both lead from your own ideas and constructively pressure-test others', as a true creative and strategic partner to PMs.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers, content, and data science across the full experiment lifecycle, from concept to bug bash to results.
  • Excellent organizational habits: clean, well-documented Figma files and clear, traceable rationale for design decisions.
  • Fluency in Figma; familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling (e.g., Optimizely, Amplitude, Statsig, or similar) is a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate design and production work.
  • Strong visual design craft, with hands-on animation skills.
  • A portfolio that showcases experimentation work, problem framing, hypotheses, iteration, and measurable impact, not just polished final screens.

Ways of Working

  • Operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, balancing multiple experiments at once.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Experiment briefs often start loosely defined, and it's the designer's job to validate the underlying problem (through research or data) and refine it into something well-scoped enough to actually test, confirming or challenging the original assumptions along the way.
  • Contributes ideas proactively, including in regular ideation sessions focused on a specific theme, bringing forward experiment concepts, not just executing others'.
  • Partners with PMs as a true collaborator: leads projects that originate from their own ideas, and acts as a critical partner on PM-originated ideas, pressure-testing them for UX soundness and product fit rather than simply executing.

  • Participates in bug bashes, testing experiments before launch to confirm the experience matches intent.
  • Uses AI as a creative and productivity partner, leveraging skills, automation, and AI-generated illustrations or animations where it makes sense, to move faster and free up more time for craft.

  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.

  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Vice President, Channels and Alliances

Location: Remote Australia

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Manager to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing reseller partnerships in Australia & New Zealand to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. You will use your knowledge of the security landscape to open opportunities and build key partner relationships with resellers at the regional and national level(s).

This role will work closely with senior sales leaders and other stakeholders on the revenue team to determine the actions necessary to identify opportunities for new routes to market to increase both revenue and the company’s market presence. You will work to identify value creation opportunities, shape and align implementation and support the reseller’s execution and long-term success.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify, recruit and onboard new reseller partners across Australia and New Zealand who align with our target market and capabilities, then provide them with the necessary training and support to quickly activate and effectively sell our solutions
  • Create a strategic plan to maximize sales through the reseller and distributor channels, including defining sales targets, incentives, and marketing initiatives to drive partner-sourced pipeline and closed revenue
  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers at reseller and distributor companies, ensuring they are actively promoting our products and addressing any concerns they may have
  • Provide resellers with the tools, resources, and ongoing training necessary to effectively present and sell our products to their customers
  • Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation
  • Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential
  • Work with ANZ distribution partners as a force multiplier for partner recruitment, enablement and scale, including joint campaigns, roadshows and other related activities
  • Work with the marketing team to develop joint marketing campaigns and materials to generate leads and support reseller sales efforts
  • Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days and other related conferences
  • Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 7+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner management and/or distribution
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including different product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends particularly in the SMB and Commercial customer segments
  • Proven track record of identifying, recruiting and quickly activating resellers, including an understanding of partner dynamics and incentive structures. Existing key reseller relationships are highly preferred.
  • SMB and Commercial mindset with a bias for action and execution
  • Experience and knowledge of MSFT licensing and Security solutions highly preferred.
  • Confident, credible communicator who can open doors and build trust quickly with key decision makers at reseller companies and foster long-term partnerships
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing a wide geographic territory
  • Willingness to travel across Australia and New Zealand

  • Fully remote work
  • At least one annual trip to the US for Summer Summit, with additional local events in Australia!
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement ($800 AUD)
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave for both primary and secondary carers
  • Monthly digital allowance for personal phone and internet costs ($185 AUD)
  • Monthly home office tech stipend to upgrade or replace equipment ($40 AUD)
  • Subsidised private health insurance through our preferred provider
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth
